scope: Root-phase, nonterminal, unit-propagation fixed-point states within the frozen original-N N^2 state envelope, with at least one live root variable and before root-free v3 tail mode.

definitions.n: number of live variables in F
definitions.P: total nondegenerate sign-aware unordered literal-pair incidences, equivalently sum_C binom(|C|,2)
definitions.T: maximum frequency of any one sign-aware literal-pair type
definitions.d_x: number of clauses containing x or -x
definitions.A_x: sum over clauses containing x or -x of (|C|-1)

identities: there are at most 2n(n-1) nondegenerate sign-aware unordered literal-pair types

lemma_1_all_pivot_overflow_forces_pair_m.name: ALL_PIVOT_OVERFLOW_PAIR_INCIDENCE_FLOOR
lemma_1_all_pivot_overflow_forces_pair_m.statement: If every live Davis-Putnam pivot exceeds the frozen monotone N^2 raw cap, then 2mP + (mL)/4 > n(N^2-s). Equivalently P > n(N^2-s)/(2m) - L/8.
proof: For pivot x, the raw multiset upper bound from the elimination accounting is at most s + d_x^2/4 + d_x A_x after dropping negative terms.

If the implementation's monotone raw set actually overflows N^2, then the completed raw set would exceed N^2, hence every valid upper bound on that completed set must also exceed N^2. Therefore d_x^2/4 + d_x A_x > N^2-s.
Sum over all n live pivots: n(N^2-s) < sum_x[d_x^2/4+d_xA_x].
Because d_x<=m, d_x^2<=m d_x and d_xA_x<=mA_x.
Use sum_x d_x=L and sum_x A_x=2P to get sum_x[d_x^2/4+d_xA_x] <= mL/4+2mP.
Combining the strict lower and upper inequalities yields 2mP+mL/4>n(N^2-s).

lemma_2_no_v2_trigger_caps_pair_mass.name: NO_FREQUENT_PAIR_PAIR_INCIDENCE_CEILING
lemma_2_no_v2_trigger_caps_pair_mass.statement: Assume s>=2N and no sign-aware literal pair reaches the proved v2 trigger T>=s-2N+11. Since frequencies are integers, T<=s-2N+10 and therefore P<=2n(n-1)(s-2N+10).
proof: Every pair incidence belongs to one of at most 4*binom(n,2)=2n(n-1) sign-aware pair types.
If the v2 trigger is absent, each type appears at most s-2N+10 times.
Summing over pair types yields the ceiling.

sandwich_theorem.name: ALL_PIVOT_OVERFLOW_V2_SANDWICH_CORRIDOR
sandwich_theorem.statement: Under the stated scope and s>=2N, if the integer condition holds, it is impossible that both (a) every ordinary exact pivot overflows the N^2 monotone cap and (b) the v2 frequent-pair trigger is absent. Therefore at least one frozen theorem-mode certified action exists: either first_capped_elimination finds an exact ordinary pivot, or the already-proved v2 frequent-pair rescue condition holds.
proof: Lemma 1 says all-pivot overflow requires P > n(N^2-s)/(2m)-L/8.
Lemma 2 says absence of the v2 trigger requires P <= 2n(n-1)(s-2N+10).
The integer condition is exactly the assertion that the Lemma-1 lower threshold is >= the Lemma-2 upper ceiling after multiplication by positive 8m.
Thus all-pivot overflow and no-v2 cannot coexist.

The frozen decision core scans every canonical ordinary pivot before v2. Hence existence of a fitting ordinary pivot is algorithmically discoverable by its existing exact capped scan; otherwise the v2 frequency theorem supplies the certified rescue condition.

algorithmic_cost.certificate_statistics: m,L,n,s,P,T are computable by deterministic syntactic scans in polynomial time in the explicit current representation size; under GPEI that size is polynomial in original N.

remaining_wedge.name: ALL_VARIABLE_BALANCED_PRESSURE_WEDGE
remaining_wedge.interpretation: A surviving obstruction must distribute enough two-sided elimination pressure over essentially every live variable while keeping that pressure sufficiently dispersed that no single literal pair crosses the v2 repetition threshold.

next_exact_target: Attack the ALL_VARIABLE_BALANCED_PRESSURE_WEDGE by summing stronger sign-split bucket inequalities, or construct a reachable exact witness. A finite search failure is not proof.
